name: Dish with Laozi Riding a Water Buffalo (interior); Pavilion and Immortals in Rocky Landscape (exterior)
dimensions: Diameter: 19.9 cm (7 13/16 in.); Overall: 7.2 cm (2 13/16 in.)
summary: Daoism traces its origins to Laozi, a sage believed to have lived in the sixth century BC, who was the reputed author of the Daode jing (Classic of the Way), a fundamental text for Daoism.
